issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
A synthetic check for HuTian issue #326 (Antigravity CLI as a system under test, by subscription). It is not research: do only this, briefly.

In its first turn, paper-repo writes `probe.md` in its repository with each command below, its exact output or error (trimmed to 20 lines), and pushes it. Run them as written; do not try other ways around a failure.

1. `curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash` (the official installer), then `~/.local/bin/agy --version`
2. `AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_URL="$(ht-resource url gemini-subscription)" AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_API_KEY="$HT_RESOURCE_TOKEN" ~/.local/bin/agy -p 'What is 6 times 7? Answer with the number only.' --model gemini-3.8-flash --output-format json --print-timeout 180s`

internal-review-repo reviews probe.md: it accepts when step 2's JSON has status SUCCESS and response 42, and says what failed otherwise.
